definitions.name: U3C.JOINSP
definitions.body: '' [ 'EL' BIND ' ' EL 3 COLLECT JOIN ] FOLD TRIM
definitions.note: Vector of Strings -> one String joined by single spaces

definitions.name: U3C.TITLE
definitions.body: LOWER 'W' BIND W CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER C 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: String word -> lower case with its first letter in upper case

definitions.name: U3C.FIRSTMAX
definitions.note: Vector of numbers -> index of its first maximum

definitions.name: U3C.STK
definitions.body: [ 'Z' ] [ 'CH' BIND 'ST' BIND ST -1 TAKE 0 GET CH 2 COLLECT JOIN 'PR' BIND PR '()' EQ NOT PR '[]' EQ NOT AND NOT 'TR' BIND ST -1 DROP ST CH 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 TR SELECT GET ] FOLD
definitions.note: Vector of single bracket Strings -> final stack as a Vector (sentinel 'Z' at bottom); a close that does not match the top is pushed, so the length minus one is the unmatched count

definitions.name: U3C.PREV
definitions.body: 'XV' BIND XV 0 GET 1 COLLECT XV XV LENGTH 1 SUB TAKE CONCAT
definitions.note: Vector -> the vector shifted right by one place, its first element repeated in front

definitions.name: U3C.RUNIDS
definitions.body: 'XV' BIND XV U3C.PREV 'XB' BIND XV XB LT NOT XV XB GT NOT AND NOT 'XT' BIND 1 0 XT SELECT 0 [ ADD ] SCAN
definitions.note: Vector of numbers -> run id at each position, the id rising by one at every change of value

definitions.name: U3C.MED
definitions.body: SORT 'S' BIND S S LENGTH 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET S S LENGTH 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: Vector of numbers -> median (mean of the two middle numbers when the count is even)

definitions.name: U3C.MISS
definitions.note: Vector of readings -> numeric flags, 1 where the reading is missing and 0 where present

definitions.name: U3C.BYNAME
definitions.body: 'E' BIND E [ 0 GET ] MAP E [ 1 GET ] MAP U2A.GSUM
definitions.note: Vector of [name amount] entries -> Record from each name to the sum of its amounts
